user.title: SB Scheduler
user.description:
Day-sets are named groups of dates — Workday, School Day, Trash Day — that schedules can run against. Pick a workday calendar and Workday and Non-workday are created for you; add a days-off calendar too and time off will cancel a workday, while an entry titled "Workday" reinstates one.

The Workday integration publishes a workday calendar (typically calendar.workday_sensor_us_calendar). Leave both empty to start with just Daily and Weekend.

abort.single_instance_allowed: SB Scheduler is already set up.

add.title: Add a day-set
add.description:
A day-set is a named group of dates, built in three tiers:

1. **Base** — the weekdays and calendars it is made of
2. **Cancelled** — what takes a day back out
3. **Always** — what overrides a cancellation

Dates accept single days and ranges: 2026-12-25, 2027-06-05..2027-08-17

data.name: Name
data.exclude_match: Only cancel when the entry matches
data.force_match: Only force when the entry matches
data.invert: Invert (every date NOT in this set)

data_description.weekdays: The base tier, together with the calendars below. Leave empty if the day-set comes entirely from a calendar, such as Trash Day.
data_description.base_calendars: What this day-set is made of — e.g. the Workday integration's calendar.
data_description.exclude_calendars: These cancel a day — e.g. a days-off calendar for time off.
data_description.exclude_match: Optional text matched against an event's title or description, so only some entries cancel. Leave empty to cancel on any entry.
data_description.force_calendars: These win over everything, including the cancellations above.
data_description.force_match: Optional text matched against an event's title or description — e.g. "Workday" so only a days-off entry named that reinstates a workday.
data_description.invert: Turns Workday into Non-workday without configuring it twice.

edit.title: Edit {name}
edit.description:
Precedence is Always > Cancelled > Base.

Dates accept single days and ranges: 2026-12-25, 2027-06-05..2027-08-17
